p.t: Unexpected Improvements to Expected Improvement for Bayesian Optimization
p.d: 研究贝叶斯优化中期望改进采集函数的数值稳定性，通过改进其计算方式帮助算法更可靠地选择下一次评估的位置。
p.e: Studies the numerical stability of the expected-improvement acquisition function in Bayesian optimization, improving how it is computed so the algorithm more reliably chooses where to evaluate next.

p.t: Large Language Models to Enhance Bayesian Optimization
p.d: 探索如何将大语言模型的先验知识引入贝叶斯优化，用于辅助搜索昂贵黑箱函数的较优解。
p.e: Explores bringing the prior knowledge of large language models into Bayesian optimization to help search for good solutions of expensive black-box functions.

p.t: Bayesian Optimization of Function Networks with Partial Evaluations
p.d: 面向由多个函数组成的计算网络，研究只评估部分模块时如何开展贝叶斯优化，以减少不必要的整体计算。
p.e: For computation networks made of several functions, studies how to run Bayesian optimization when only some modules are evaluated, avoiding unnecessary full computations.

p.t: Scaling Multi-Task Bayesian Optimization with Large Language Models
p.d: 研究借助大语言模型扩展多任务贝叶斯优化，让多个优化任务中的信息能够被共同利用。
p.e: Uses large language models to scale multi-task Bayesian optimization so that information from many optimization tasks can be shared.

p.t: Unleashing LLMs in Bayesian Optimization: Preference-Guided Framework for Scientific Discovery
p.d: 探索把偏好信息与大语言模型结合起来指导贝叶斯优化，面向科学发现中的候选搜索问题。
p.e: Combines preference information with large language models to guide Bayesian optimization for candidate search in scientific discovery.

p.t: Deep Batch Active Learning by Diverse, Uncertain Gradient Lower Bounds
p.d: 在主动学习中兼顾样本的不确定性与多样性，选择更值得人工标注的一批数据，减少重复或低价值的标注。
p.e: Balances uncertainty and diversity in active learning to pick batches that are most worth labelling, reducing redundant or low-value annotation.

p.t: Active Preference Learning for Large Language Models
p.d: 研究如何主动挑选大语言模型最需要学习的偏好样本，让有限的反馈预算用于更有信息量的比较。
p.e: Studies how to actively choose the preference examples a large language model most needs, so a limited feedback budget goes to more informative comparisons.

p.t: Active Learning of Deep Neural Networks via Gradient-Free Cutting Planes
p.d: 探索不依赖梯度的切平面方法来选择深度网络的主动学习样本，关注有限标注预算下的信息获取。
p.e: Explores gradient-free cutting-plane methods for selecting active-learning samples for deep networks, focusing on information gain under a limited labelling budget.

p.t: A Minimalist Approach to Offline Reinforcement Learning
p.d: 以简洁的离线强化学习方法为出发点，将策略学习与行为克隆结合，使智能体能够利用已有数据学习动作。
p.e: Starts from a minimalist offline reinforcement learning method that combines policy learning with behaviour cloning, letting agents learn actions from existing data.

p.t: Revisiting the Minimalist Approach to Offline Reinforcement Learning
p.d: 重新审视简洁的离线强化学习方案，研究设计和训练选择如何影响从固定数据集学习策略的效果。
p.e: Revisits minimalist offline reinforcement learning, examining how design and training choices affect learning policies from a fixed dataset.

p.t: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
p.d: 将生成过程写成从噪声逐步恢复数据的去噪过程，是理解扩散模型训练与采样机制的重要基础。
p.e: Frames generation as a denoising process that gradually recovers data from noise; a key foundation for understanding how diffusion models are trained and sampled.

p.t: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
p.d: 用 Transformer 构建扩散生成模型，研究模型架构与规模扩展如何支持更强的图像生成能力。
p.e: Builds diffusion models on Transformers, studying how architecture and scaling support stronger image generation.

p.t: DiGress: Discrete Denoising Diffusion for Graph Generation
p.d: 将扩散去噪应用到离散图结构，学习生成节点及其连接关系，面向分子等图数据的生成任务。
p.e: Applies diffusion denoising to discrete graphs, learning to generate nodes and their connections for tasks such as molecule generation.

p.t: Crystal Structure Prediction by Joint Equivariant Diffusion
p.d: 用联合等变扩散方法预测晶体结构，关注晶格与原子位置之间的协调，以及结构对称性在生成中的作用。
p.e: Predicts crystal structures with joint equivariant diffusion, coordinating lattice and atomic positions and exploiting structural symmetry during generation.

p.t: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
p.d: 通过学习连续变化的速度场，把简单分布中的样本逐步输送到目标数据分布，为生成建模提供流匹配框架。
p.e: Learns a continuously varying velocity field that transports samples from a simple distribution to the data distribution, providing the flow matching framework for generative modelling.

p.t: Flow Matching on General Geometries
p.d: 将流匹配推广到更一般的几何空间，研究数据受曲面或流形约束时如何构建生成过程。
p.e: Extends flow matching to general geometric spaces, studying how to build generative processes when data are constrained to curved surfaces or manifolds.

p.t: Discrete Flow Matching
p.d: 把流匹配的思想扩展到离散状态空间，研究如何通过离散状态转换生成目标数据。
p.e: Extends flow matching to discrete state spaces, generating target data through transitions between discrete states.

p.t: Trajectory Balance: Improved Credit Assignment in GFlowNets
p.d: 提出面向 GFlowNet 的轨迹平衡训练目标，关注如何将最终候选的奖励传回生成路径中的各个决策。
p.e: Proposes the trajectory balance objective for GFlowNets, addressing how the reward of a final candidate is propagated back to each decision along the generation path.

p.t: Multi-Objective GFlowNets
p.d: 研究同时面对多个目标时的 GFlowNet 生成，让候选搜索能够覆盖不同目标权衡下的多样解。
p.e: Studies GFlowNet generation with multiple objectives, so candidate search can cover diverse solutions across different trade-offs.

p.t: Generalization and Distributed Learning of GFlowNets
p.d: 研究 GFlowNet 的泛化与分布式学习，关注生成策略如何利用不同来源的探索经验。
p.e: Studies generalisation and distributed learning in GFlowNets, focusing on how a generation policy can use exploration experience from different sources.

p.t: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
p.d: 把外部文档检索与语言模型生成结合起来，让模型能够参考检索到的材料回答知识密集型问题。
p.e: Combines retrieval of external documents with language model generation, letting the model consult retrieved material to answer knowledge-intensive questions.

p.t: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
p.d: 让模型学习判断何时检索，并对生成内容进行自我反思与评判，将检索和回答质量控制结合起来。
p.e: Teaches the model to decide when to retrieve and to reflect on and critique its own output, combining retrieval with control of answer quality.

p.t: DeepRAG: Thinking to Retrieve Step by Step for Large Language Models
p.d: 研究将逐步推理与检索交织起来的回答流程，让复杂问题的信息需求在推理过程中逐步被处理。
p.e: Studies an answering process that interleaves step-by-step reasoning with retrieval, so the information needs of complex questions are handled progressively during reasoning.

p.t: Improving Text Embeddings with Large Language Models
p.d: 利用大语言模型生成多样化的合成训练数据，再通过对比学习训练文本嵌入模型，使文本向量更适合语义检索等任务。
p.e: Uses large language models to generate diverse synthetic training data and then trains text embedding models with contrastive learning, producing vectors better suited to semantic retrieval.

p.t: NV-Embed: Improved Techniques for Training LLMs as Generalist Embedding Models
p.d: 研究将大语言模型训练为通用文本嵌入模型的改进技术，目标是让同一套向量表示服务于多种文本理解与检索任务。
p.e: Studies improved techniques for training large language models as general-purpose text embedding models, so one set of vectors serves many text understanding and retrieval tasks.

p.t: Unified Structure Generation for Universal Information Extraction
p.d: 把不同的信息抽取任务统一为结构化内容生成，使用同一种建模形式提取实体、关系等信息。
p.e: Unifies different information extraction tasks as structured generation, extracting entities, relations and more with a single modelling form.

p.t: Instruct and Extract: Instruction Tuning for On-Demand Information Extraction
p.d: 通过指令微调进行按需信息抽取，让模型根据用户描述的需求从文本中提取目标信息。
p.e: Uses instruction tuning for on-demand information extraction, letting the model pull out whatever information the user describes.

p.t: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
p.d: 把语言推理与工具行动交替组织起来，让智能体在获取外部反馈后继续调整思路和行动。
p.e: Interleaves language reasoning with tool actions, so an agent keeps adjusting its thinking and actions after receiving external feedback.

p.t: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
p.d: 研究让语言模型学习调用工具，包括何时调用、如何传递参数，以及怎样将工具结果用于后续生成。
p.e: Teaches language models to use tools: when to call them, how to pass arguments and how to use the results in later generation.

p.t: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
p.d: 让语言智能体将任务反馈整理成文字反思，并在后续尝试中利用这些经验改进行动。
p.e: Has language agents turn task feedback into written reflections and use that experience to improve their actions in later attempts.

p.t: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
p.d: 对同一问题采样多条推理路径，再综合其答案的一致性，减少单次推理偶然出错的影响。
p.e: Samples multiple reasoning paths for the same question and aggregates their answers by consistency, reducing the effect of a single faulty chain.

p.t: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
p.d: 把推理过程组织成可探索的思维树，通过评估和选择不同分支来处理需要规划的问题。
p.e: Organises reasoning as an explorable tree of thoughts, evaluating and selecting branches to handle problems that require planning.

p.t: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models
p.d: 将树搜索引入语言智能体，把推理、行动与规划放进同一个搜索过程，探索不同决策路径。
p.e: Brings tree search to language agents, placing reasoning, acting and planning in one search process to explore different decision paths.

p.t: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
p.d: 将多智能体协作组织为具有分工的工作流程，研究多个语言模型角色如何共同完成复杂任务。
p.e: Organises multi-agent collaboration as a workflow with division of labour, studying how several language-model roles complete complex tasks together.

p.t: ReConcile: Round-Table Conference Improves Reasoning via Consensus among Diverse LLMs
p.d: 让不同语言模型通过多轮讨论形成共识，研究模型间的信息交换如何辅助复杂问题推理。
p.e: Has different language models reach consensus through multi-round discussion, studying how information exchange between models aids complex reasoning.

p.m: NeurIPS · Datasets & Benchmarks 2023 · 框架入口
p.t: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
p.d: 研究用语言模型评审及人类偏好比较评估对话模型，并通过 MT-Bench 与 Chatbot Arena 探索评测的一致性与偏差。
p.e: Studies evaluating chat models with LLM judges and human preference comparisons, using MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena to examine agreement and bias.

p.t: G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment
p.d: 使用 GPT-4 评估生成文本的质量，研究自动评价如何更贴近人类对文本的判断。
p.e: Uses GPT-4 to evaluate the quality of generated text, studying how automatic evaluation can better match human judgement.

p.t: Prometheus: Inducing Fine-Grained Evaluation Capability in Language Models
p.d: 训练能够依据细粒度评价标准给出反馈的语言模型，面向生成内容的自动评审与评分。
p.e: Trains a language model that gives feedback according to fine-grained rubrics, for automatic review and scoring of generated content.

p.t: FActScore: Fine-Grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
p.d: 将长文本拆分为可核查的原子事实，并评价其中有多少得到证据支持，使事实性评价更加细致。
p.e: Splits long-form text into checkable atomic facts and measures how many are supported by evidence, making factuality evaluation more fine-grained.

p.t: Long-form Factuality in Large Language Models
p.d: 面向语言模型生成的长篇回答，研究如何系统检查其中的事实性，并构建相应评测任务。
p.e: Studies how to systematically check the factuality of long answers generated by language models, and builds a corresponding benchmark.

p.t: Conformal Risk Control
p.d: 将共形方法用于风险控制，研究如何借助校准数据使模型输出满足预设的风险要求。
p.e: Applies conformal methods to risk control, using calibration data so that model outputs meet a prescribed risk level.

p.t: Conformal Language Modeling
p.d: 将共形预测引入语言建模，探索如何为语言模型的输出提供经过校准的不确定性控制。
p.e: Brings conformal prediction to language modelling, exploring calibrated uncertainty control for language model outputs.

p.t: Language Models with Conformal Factuality Guarantees
p.d: 研究利用共形方法控制语言模型回答的事实性风险，关注生成内容与统计保证之间的联系。
p.e: Uses conformal methods to control the factuality risk of language model answers, linking generated content to statistical guarantees.

p.t: CoFact: Conformal Factuality Guarantees for Language Models under Covariate Shift
p.d: 研究输入分布发生协变量偏移时，如何为语言模型维持共形事实性保证。
p.e: Studies how to maintain conformal factuality guarantees for language models when the input distribution undergoes covariate shift.

p.t: Domain-Shift-Aware Conformal Prediction for Large Language Models
p.d: 研究面向领域变化的共形预测，使语言模型的不确定性处理能够考虑训练与应用环境之间的分布差异。
p.e: Studies conformal prediction under domain shift, so uncertainty handling in language models accounts for differences between training and deployment distributions.

p.t: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model Is Secretly a Reward Model
p.d: 直接利用偏好比较数据优化语言模型，使模型更倾向于生成用户偏好的回答，简化偏好对齐流程。
p.e: Optimises language models directly on preference comparison data so they favour preferred responses, simplifying preference alignment.

p.t: SimPO: Simple Preference Optimization with a Reference-Free Reward
p.d: 研究不依赖参考模型的简单偏好优化方法，降低语言模型偏好训练中的流程复杂度。
p.e: Studies a simple preference optimization method that needs no reference model, reducing the complexity of preference training.

p.t: Model Alignment as Prospect Theoretic Optimization
p.d: 从前景理论的角度设计模型对齐目标，探索如何利用对输出好坏的反馈来调整语言模型行为。
p.e: Designs an alignment objective from the perspective of prospect theory, exploring how feedback on whether outputs are good or bad can adjust model behaviour.

p.t: MiniLLM: Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
p.d: 研究大语言模型的知识蒸馏，使较小的学生模型能够学习较大教师模型的生成行为。
p.e: Studies knowledge distillation for large language models so a smaller student can learn the generation behaviour of a larger teacher.

p.t: DistiLLM: Towards Streamlined Distillation for Large Language Models
p.d: 探索更精简的大语言模型蒸馏流程，关注如何有效地将教师模型的能力传递给学生模型。
p.e: Explores a more streamlined distillation pipeline for large language models, focusing on transferring teacher capabilities to the student effectively.

p.t: DistiLLM-2: A Contrastive Approach Boosts the Distillation of LLMs
p.d: 将对比学习思路引入语言模型蒸馏，研究通过区分不同生成样本来改进教师到学生的知识迁移。
p.e: Brings contrastive ideas into language model distillation, improving teacher-to-student transfer by distinguishing between different generated samples.

p.t: Large Language Model Unlearning
p.d: 研究让大语言模型遗忘指定知识或数据影响的方法，面向训练后知识移除与模型行为调整。
p.e: Studies methods for making large language models forget specified knowledge or the influence of specific data, for post-training knowledge removal and behaviour adjustment.

p.t: Invariance Makes LLM Unlearning Resilient Even to Unanticipated Downstream Fine-Tuning
p.d: 研究怎样使语言模型的遗忘效果在后续微调后仍能保持，关注被移除知识重新显现的问题。
p.e: Studies how to keep unlearning effective after later fine-tuning, addressing the re-emergence of removed knowledge.

p.t: Improved Distribution Matching for Dataset Condensation
p.d: 通过改进分布匹配来进行数据集浓缩，把较大数据集中的训练信息压缩到更小的合成数据集。
p.e: Improves distribution matching for dataset condensation, compressing the training information of a large dataset into a much smaller synthetic one.

p.t: DREAM: Efficient Dataset Distillation by Representative Matching
p.d: 利用代表性匹配进行数据集蒸馏，研究如何选取和匹配更有代表性的训练信息以提高蒸馏效率。
p.e: Uses representative matching for dataset distillation, studying how selecting and matching more representative training information improves efficiency.

p.t: Towards Stable Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Wild World
p.d: 研究动态测试环境中的模型适应，关注输入不断变化时如何避免测试时更新造成不稳定。
p.e: Studies model adaptation in dynamic test environments, focusing on avoiding instability from test-time updates as inputs keep changing.

p.t: Robust Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Scenarios
p.d: 面向动态场景开展鲁棒测试时适应，研究模型如何在持续变化的数据流中调整自身。
p.e: Develops robust test-time adaptation for dynamic scenes, studying how a model adjusts itself on a continually changing data stream.

p.t: Test-Time Adaptation with Binary Feedback
p.d: 研究仅利用二元反馈进行测试时适应，让模型在缺少完整标签的情况下借助简化反馈调整。
p.e: Studies test-time adaptation with only binary feedback, letting a model adjust with simplified signals when full labels are unavailable.

p.t: Equiformer: Equivariant Graph Attention Transformer for 3D Atomistic Graphs
p.d: 将等变性与图注意力结合起来建模三维原子体系，使模型在空间旋转等变换下保持合理的几何响应。
p.e: Combines equivariance with graph attention to model 3D atomic systems, so the model responds correctly to spatial rotations and other transformations.

p.t: EquiformerV2: Improved Equivariant Transformer for Scaling to Higher-Degree Representations
p.d: 改进等变 Transformer 对高阶几何表示的处理，探索更可扩展的三维原子体系建模方式。
p.e: Improves how equivariant Transformers handle higher-order geometric representations, exploring more scalable modelling of 3D atomic systems.

p.t: Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations

p.d: 利用温度驱动的主动学习构建 MOF 机器学习势，研究如何选择训练构型以近似量子化学能量与作用力。
p.e: Builds machine-learned potentials for MOFs with temperature-driven active learning, studying how to choose training configurations that approximate quantum-chemical energies and forces.

p.m: ACS Nano 2025 · 计算＋机器学习势
p.t: Toward a Generalizable Machine-Learned Potential for Metal–Organic Frameworks
p.d: 探索可泛化的 MOF 机器学习势，关注势能模型在不同框架或构型之间的适用范围。
p.e: Explores generalisable machine-learned potentials for MOFs, focusing on how far a potential applies across frameworks and configurations.

p.m: Chemistry of Materials 2025 · 多尺度计算
p.t: Cluster-Based Machine Learning Potentials to Describe Disordered Metal–Organic Frameworks up to the Mesoscale
p.d: 以簇为基础构建机器学习势…36288 tokens truncated…operators to handle genomic contexts of up to a million bases at single-nucleotide resolution, with strong results on several genomics tasks.

p.t: Sequence modeling and design from molecular to genome scale with Evo
p.d: 在大规模原核与噬菌体基因组上训练长上下文生成模型 Evo，能预测突变效应，并生成经实验验证的 CRISPR-Cas 系统和转座子。
p.e: Trains Evo, a long-context generative model, on large collections of prokaryotic and phage genomes; it predicts mutational effects and generates experimentally validated CRISPR-Cas systems and transposons.

p.t: Nucleotide Transformer: building and evaluating robust foundation models for human genomics
p.d: 在人类与多物种基因组上预训练不同规模的 DNA 基础模型，并在剪接、启动子、变异效应等任务上系统评估其迁移效果。
p.e: Pretrains DNA foundation models of several sizes on human and multi-species genomes and systematically evaluates transfer on tasks such as splicing, promoters and variant effects.

p.t: Deep generative modeling for single-cell transcriptomics
p.d: 用深度生成模型对单细胞转录组计数建模，在一个统一概率框架中完成降维、批次校正和差异表达分析。
p.e: Models single-cell transcriptome counts with a deep generative model, performing dimensionality reduction, batch correction and differential expression in one probabilistic framework.

p.t: Transfer learning enables predictions in network biology
p.d: 在约三千万个单细胞转录组上预训练 Transformer，把细胞表示为按表达排序的基因序列，可迁移到基因网络和疾病靶点预测。
p.e: Pretrains a Transformer on about 30 million single-cell transcriptomes, representing each cell as genes ranked by expression, and transfers it to gene network and disease target prediction.

p.t: scGPT: toward building a foundation model for single-cell multi-omics using generative AI
p.d: 在三千多万个细胞上生成式预训练单细胞基础模型 scGPT，微调后可用于细胞类型注释、多组学整合和扰动响应预测。
p.e: Generatively pretrains the single-cell foundation model scGPT on over 30 million cells; after fine-tuning it handles cell-type annotation, multi-omic integration and perturbation response prediction.

p.t: Zero-shot evaluation reveals limitations of single-cell foundation models
p.d: 在不微调的零样本条件下评估 Geneformer 和 scGPT，发现它们在细胞聚类和批次整合上常不如高变基因等简单基线。
p.e: Evaluates Geneformer and scGPT zero-shot without fine-tuning and finds they often underperform simple baselines such as highly variable genes on cell clustering and batch integration.

p.t: Disease variant prediction with deep generative models of evolutionary data
p.d: 用变分自编码器学习蛋白家族的进化序列分布，不依赖临床标签即可预测错义变异的致病性，效果可比有监督方法。
p.e: Learns the evolutionary sequence distribution of protein families with a variational autoencoder, predicting the pathogenicity of missense variants without clinical labels and matching supervised methods.

p.m: Molecular Systems Biology 2023 · 近年代表
p.t: Predicting cellular responses to complex perturbations in high-throughput screens
p.d: 提出组合扰动自编码器，在隐空间中把细胞基础状态与药物、剂量和遗传扰动的效应分开，可预测未见组合的表达响应。
p.e: Introduces the compositional perturbation autoencoder, which separates basal cell state from the effects of drugs, doses and genetic perturbations in latent space and predicts expression responses to unseen combinations.

p.t: Accurate proteome-wide missense variant effect prediction with AlphaMissense
p.d: 结合结构预测与蛋白质语言模型，对人类全部约七千一百万种可能的错义变异给出致病性评分，并公开了预测结果。
p.e: Combines structure prediction with a protein language model to score the pathogenicity of all roughly 71 million possible human missense variants, and releases the predictions.

p.t: Predicting transcriptional outcomes of novel multigene perturbations with GEARS
p.d: 用包含基因间关系的知识图增强图神经网络，预测单基因和多基因扰动后的转录变化，包括训练中从未见过的扰动组合。
p.e: Augments a graph neural network with a knowledge graph of gene–gene relationships to predict transcriptional changes after single- and multi-gene perturbations, including combinations never seen in training.

p.t: nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation
p.d: 提出能根据数据集属性自动配置预处理、网络结构和训练策略的 U-Net 框架，在大量医学分割竞赛中无需手工调参即达到领先水平。
p.e: Introduces a U-Net framework that configures preprocessing, architecture and training automatically from dataset properties, reaching top results in many medical segmentation challenges without manual tuning.

p.m: Radiology: Artificial Intelligence 2023 · 近年代表
p.t: TotalSegmentator: Robust Segmentation of 104 Anatomic Structures in CT Images
p.d: 基于 nnU-Net 训练可分割 CT 中 104 种解剖结构的模型，在多种扫描条件下表现稳健，并作为开源工具广泛使用。
p.e: Trains an nnU-Net-based model that segments 104 anatomical structures in CT, robust across scanning conditions and widely used as an open-source tool.

p.t: Segment anything in medical images
p.d: 把通用分割模型 SAM 在超过一百万对医学图像与掩码上微调，得到可用边框提示分割多种模态和部位的通用医学分割模型。
p.e: Fine-tunes the general segmentation model SAM on over a million medical image–mask pairs, producing a general medical segmentation model driven by box prompts across many modalities and body regions.

p.m: Nature Biomedical Engineering 2021 · 较早入口
p.t: Data-efficient and weakly supervised computational pathology on whole-slide images
p.d: 提出基于注意力的多实例学习方法，只需切片级标签即可训练全切片分类模型，并给出可解释的重要区域热图。
p.e: Introduces attention-based multiple-instance learning that trains whole-slide classifiers from slide-level labels alone and produces interpretable heatmaps of important regions.

p.t: Towards a general-purpose foundation model for computational pathology
p.d: 在十万多张全切片、上亿图块上自监督预训练病理视觉基础模型 UNI，并在三十多项临床任务上评估其通用性。
p.e: Self-supervised pretraining of the pathology vision foundation model UNI on over 100,000 whole slides and hundreds of millions of tiles, evaluated for generality on more than 30 clinical tasks.

p.t: A visual-language foundation model for computational pathology
p.d: 在一百多万对病理图像与文本描述上预训练视觉语言模型，支持零样本分类、图文检索和图像描述等任务。
p.e: Pretrains a vision-language model on over a million pathology image–caption pairs, supporting zero-shot classification, image–text retrieval and captioning.

p.t: A whole-slide foundation model for digital pathology from real-world data
p.d: 利用大规模真实世界病理数据，结合图块编码器与长序列 Transformer 对整张切片建模，在癌症分型和突变预测上表现领先。
p.e: Uses large-scale real-world pathology data and combines a tile encoder with a long-sequence Transformer to model whole slides, leading on cancer subtyping and mutation prediction.

p.m: Nature Biomedical Engineering 2022 · 较早入口
p.t: Expert-level detection of pathologies from unannotated chest X-ray images via self-supervised learning
p.d: 用胸部 X 光片与放射报告做图文对比学习，不需要人工标注即可零样本检测多种病变，性能接近放射科医生。
p.e: Applies image–text contrastive learning to chest X-rays and radiology reports, detecting many pathologies zero-shot without manual labels at close to radiologist performance.

p.t: A foundation model for generalizable disease detection from retinal images
p.d: 用掩码自编码在一百多万张视网膜图像上预训练基础模型，可迁移到眼病诊断以及心衰、心梗等全身疾病风险预测。
p.e: Pretrains a foundation model with masked autoencoding on over a million retinal images and transfers it to eye disease diagnosis and to risk prediction for systemic diseases such as heart failure and myocardial infarction.

p.t: LLaVA-Med: Training a Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Biomedicine in One Day
p.d: 利用 PubMed Central 中的生物医学图文对和由语言模型生成的指令数据，低成本训练能回答医学图像问题的多模态对话助手。
p.e: Uses biomedical image–text pairs from PubMed Central and instruction data generated by a language model to cheaply train a multimodal assistant that answers questions about medical images.

p.m: PLOS Digital Health 2023 · 较早入口
p.t: Performance of ChatGPT on USMLE: Potential for AI-assisted medical education using large language models
p.d: 评估 ChatGPT 在美国医师执照考试三个阶段题目上的表现，发现其未经专门训练即接近及格线，并给出较连贯的解释。
p.e: Evaluates ChatGPT on questions from all three steps of the US Medical Licensing Examination, finding it approaches the pass mark without specialised training and gives fairly coherent explanations.

p.t: Large language models encode clinical knowledge
p.d: 构建汇总多种医学问答数据的 MultiMedQA 基准，并提出由医生和普通人从多个维度评价答案的框架，用指令提示微调得到 Med-PaLM。
p.e: Builds the MultiMedQA benchmark combining several medical QA datasets, proposes a framework in which clinicians and lay people rate answers along several axes, and obtains Med-PaLM through instruction prompt tuning.

p.t: Toward expert-level medical question answering with large language models
p.d: 通过医学领域微调和集成精炼等提示策略，使模型在医学考试题上达到专家水平，并在长答案上与医生答案进行了成对比较。
p.e: Uses medical fine-tuning and prompting strategies such as ensemble refinement to reach expert level on medical exam questions, with pairwise comparisons against physicians' long-form answers.

p.t: Evaluation and mitigation of the limitations of large language models in clinical decision-making
p.d: 基于真实急腹症病例构建交互式评测框架，发现语言模型在信息收集、遵循指南和完整诊疗决策上明显不如医生。
p.e: Builds an interactive evaluation framework from real abdominal-pathology cases, finding that language models fall clearly short of physicians in information gathering, guideline adherence and end-to-end clinical decisions.

p.t: Towards conversational diagnostic artificial intelligence
p.d: 用模拟问诊环境中的自博弈训练诊断对话模型 AMIE，在标准化病人测试中多数评价维度优于全科医生。
p.e: Trains the diagnostic dialogue model AMIE through self-play in a simulated consultation environment; in standardised-patient tests it outperforms primary care physicians on most evaluation axes.

p.t: Towards accurate differential diagnosis with large language models
p.d: 在疑难病例上评估为鉴别诊断优化的语言模型，发现其单独使用和辅助医生时都能提高鉴别诊断列表的准确性。
p.e: Evaluates a language model optimised for differential diagnosis on challenging cases, finding that it improves the accuracy of differential lists both alone and when assisting clinicians.

p.m: npj Digital Medicine 2022 · 较早入口
p.t: A large language model for electronic health records
p.d: 用超过九百亿词的去标识化临床文本训练大型语言模型 GatorTron，提升了临床概念抽取、问答和关系抽取等任务表现。
p.e: Trains the large clinical language model GatorTron on more than 90 billion words of de-identified clinical text, improving clinical concept extraction, question answering and relation extraction.

p.t: Health system-scale language models are all-purpose prediction engines
p.d: 在纽约大学医疗系统的临床笔记上训练语言模型，用于再入院、住院死亡和住院时长等预测，并进行了前瞻性部署评估。
p.e: Trains a language model on clinical notes from the NYU health system to predict readmission, in-hospital mortality, length of stay and more, with a prospective deployment evaluation.

p.t: Adapted large language models can outperform medical experts in clinical text summarization
p.d: 系统比较多种语言模型和适配方法在放射报告、病程问题和医患对话等摘要任务上的表现，医生读者评估中最佳模型常优于医学专家。
p.e: Systematically compares language models and adaptation methods on summarising radiology reports, patient problem lists and doctor–patient dialogues; in clinician reader studies the best model often beats medical experts.

p.t: Learning the natural history of human disease with generative transformers
p.d: 在大规模人群健康记录上训练生成式 Transformer，预测个体未来一千多种疾病的发生率和时间，并可模拟疾病轨迹。
p.e: Trains a generative Transformer on large population health records to predict the rates and timing of more than 1,000 future diseases for an individual and to simulate disease trajectories.

p.t: Underdiagnosis bias of artificial intelligence algorithms applied to chest radiographs in under-served patient populations
p.d: 分析多个胸片数据集上的分类模型，发现其对弱势群体存在系统性漏诊，交叉群体的差异更明显。
p.e: Analyses classifiers on several chest X-ray datasets and finds systematic underdiagnosis of under-served groups, with larger gaps for intersectional groups.

p.m: The Lancet Digital Health 2022 · 近年代表
p.t: AI recognition of patient race in medical imaging: a modelling study
p.d: 发现深度学习模型能在多种医学影像中准确识别患者自报种族，且这种能力难以通过简单图像处理消除，提示潜在偏差风险。
p.e: Finds that deep learning models can accurately identify patients' self-reported race from many kinds of medical images, an ability not removed by simple image processing, pointing to potential bias risks.

p.t: The limits of fair medical imaging AI in real-world generalization
p.d: 发现利用人口学捷径越多的医学影像模型公平性越差，院内去偏方法虽能改善局部公平，但在外部医院数据上不一定保持。
p.e: Finds that medical imaging models that rely more on demographic shortcuts are less fair, and that in-hospital debiasing improves local fairness but does not necessarily hold on external hospital data.

p.t: Reporting guidelines for clinical trial reports for interventions involving artificial intelligence: the CONSORT-AI extension
p.d: 在 CONSORT 临床试验报告规范基础上增加针对 AI 干预的条目，要求报告模型版本、输入数据、人机交互和错误分析等信息。
p.e: Adds AI-specific items to the CONSORT reporting guideline for clinical trials, requiring reports of model version, input data, human–AI interaction and error analysis.

p.m: JAMA Internal Medicine 2021 · 近年代表
p.t: External Validation of a Widely Implemented Proprietary Sepsis Prediction Model in Hospitalized Patients
p.d: 在一家医院的大规模住院数据上外部验证广泛使用的商业脓毒症预测模型，发现其区分能力和预警价值明显低于开发方报告。
p.e: Externally validates a widely used commercial sepsis prediction model on large inpatient data from one hospital, finding its discrimination and alerting value far below the developer's reports.

p.m: The Lancet Oncology 2023 · 已有扩展
p.t: Artificial intelligence-supported screen reading versus standard double reading in the Mammography Screening with Artificial Intelligence trial (MASAI): a clinical safety analysis of a randomised, controlled, non-inferiority, single-blinded, screening accuracy study
p.d: 在瑞典乳腺癌筛查随机对照试验中比较 AI 辅助阅片与标准双人阅片，AI 组癌症检出率相近而放射科医生阅片量明显减少。
p.e: Compares AI-supported screen reading with standard double reading in a Swedish breast cancer screening randomised trial; the AI arm had a similar cancer detection rate with a markedly lower radiologist reading workload.

p.t: Enhancing the reliability and accuracy of AI-enabled diagnosis via complementarity-driven deferral to clinicians
p.d: 提出根据 AI 置信度和医生历史表现学习交接策略的方法，在乳腺筛查和胸片诊断中使人机组合的准确性高于单独的 AI 或医生。
p.e: Proposes learning a deferral policy from AI confidence and clinicians' past performance, making the human–AI combination more accurate than either alone in breast screening and chest X-ray diagnosis.

p.t: Medical large language models are vulnerable to data-poisoning attacks
p.d: 发现在预训练语料中替换极少比例的医学内容为错误信息，就能让模型更多地输出有害医学内容，而常规医学基准难以发现。
p.e: Finds that replacing a tiny fraction of medical content in pretraining data with misinformation makes models output more harmful medical content, which standard medical benchmarks fail to detect.

p.t: A mobile robotic chemist
p.d: 让移动机器人在普通实验室中操作仪器，并用贝叶斯优化选择实验条件，自主完成大量光催化实验并找到更优配方。
p.e: Has a mobile robot operate instruments in an ordinary laboratory and choose experimental conditions with Bayesian optimization, autonomously running many photocatalysis experiments and finding a better formulation.

p.t: Autonomous chemical research with large language models
p.d: 构建以大型语言模型为核心的智能体，能检索资料、阅读仪器文档并控制自动化设备，完成钯催化偶联反应的设计与优化。
p.e: Builds an agent around a large language model that searches information, reads instrument documentation and controls automated equipment to design and optimise palladium-catalysed coupling reactions.

p.m: Nature Machine Intelligence 2024 · 已有扩展
p.t: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools
p.d: 为大型语言模型接入十多种专家设计的化学工具，使其能完成合成规划、分子设计和性质查询，并驱动自动化平台执行合成。
p.e: Connects a large language model to more than ten expert-designed chemistry tools, enabling synthesis planning, molecular design and property queries, and driving an automated platform to carry out syntheses.

p.t: BioDiscoveryAgent: An AI Agent for Designing Genetic Perturbation Experiments
p.d: 用语言模型智能体在多轮实验中选择要扰动的基因，结合文献检索和工具分析，比贝叶斯优化基线更快找到产生目标表型的基因。
p.e: Uses a language-model agent to choose which genes to perturb over multiple rounds of experiments, combining literature search and tool analysis to find genes producing a target phenotype faster than Bayesian optimization baselines.

p.t: The Virtual Lab of AI agents designs new SARS-CoV-2 nanobodies
p.d: 构建由多个扮演不同角色的语言模型智能体组成的虚拟实验室，结合 ESM、AlphaFold 等工具设计新冠纳米抗体，并经湿实验验证。
p.e: Builds a virtual laboratory of language-model agents playing different roles, which uses tools such as ESM and AlphaFold to design SARS-CoV-2 nanobodies validated in wet-lab experiments.

p.t: CRISPR-GPT for agentic automation of gene-editing experiments
p.d: 提出面向基因编辑的语言模型智能体，协助研究者选择 CRISPR 系统、设计向导 RNA 和实验方案，并在真实敲除实验中验证。
p.e: Introduces a language-model agent for gene editing that helps researchers choose CRISPR systems, design guide RNAs and plan experiments, validated in real knockout experiments.

p.t: Low-N protein engineering with data-efficient deep learning
p.d: 先用无监督序列模型学习蛋白表示，再用几十个实验测得的突变体训练模型，即可有效引导荧光蛋白和酶的工程改造。
p.e: Learns protein representations with an unsupervised sequence model and then trains on a few dozen experimentally measured mutants, effectively guiding the engineering of fluorescent proteins and enzymes.

p.t: Active learning-assisted directed evolution
p.d: 将带不确定性估计的主动学习循环加入定向进化，在突变间存在强上位效应的酶活性位点优化中，以少量实验找到高活性变体。
p.e: Adds an active-learning loop with uncertainty estimates to directed evolution, finding highly active variants with few experiments when optimising an enzyme active site with strong epistasis between mutations.

p.t: A generative deep learning approach to de novo antibiotic design
p.d: 用生成模型在巨大化学空间中设计新抗生素，筛选合成后得到对淋球菌和金黄色葡萄球菌有效、机制新颖的化合物。
p.e: Designs new antibiotics in a vast chemical space with generative models; after screening and synthesis, it obtains compounds with novel mechanisms that are effective against Neisseria gonorrhoeae and Staphylococcus aureus.

p.t: The lean mathematical library
p.d: 介绍由社区协作维护的 Lean 数学库 mathlib，强调统一的定义体系与代数层级设计，它后来成为 AI 形式化证明的主要数据来源。
p.e: Introduces mathlib, the community-maintained Lean mathematics library, emphasising a unified system of definitions and a carefully designed algebraic hierarchy; it later became the main data source for AI formal proving.

p.t: The Lean 4 Theorem Prover and Programming Language
p.d: 介绍 Lean 4，它既是定理证明器也是高效的函数式编程语言，使用户可以用同一种语言编写证明和自动化策略。
p.e: Introduces Lean 4, both a theorem prover and an efficient functional programming language, so users can write proofs and automation tactics in the same language.

p.t: MiniF2F: a cross-system benchmark for formal Olympiad-level mathematics
p.d: 构建包含 488 道奥赛与竞赛题的形式化基准，覆盖 Lean、Metamath、Isabelle 等多个系统，成为神经定理证明的常用评测。
p.e: Builds a formal benchmark of 488 olympiad and competition problems across systems such as Lean, Metamath and Isabelle; a standard evaluation for neural theorem proving.

p.t: LeanDojo: Theorem Proving with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
p.d: 提供从 Lean 中提取数据并与之交互的开源工具链和基准，并提出能从数学库中检索相关前提的检索增强证明模型 ReProver。
p.e: Provides an open-source toolkit and benchmark for extracting data from and interacting with Lean, and proposes ReProver, a retrieval-augmented prover that retrieves relevant premises from the library.

p.t: Generative Language Modeling for Automated Theorem Proving
p.d: 把生成式 Transformer 语言模型用于 Metamath 中的自动定理证明，模型找到的一些更短证明被正式收录进 Metamath 主库。
p.e: Applies generative Transformer language models to automated theorem proving in Metamath; several shorter proofs found by the model were accepted into the main Metamath library.

p.t: HyperTree Proof Search for Neural Theorem Proving
p.d: 提出受 AlphaZero 启发的超树证明搜索算法，并通过在线训练不断从自身搜索结果中学习，在 Metamath 和 Lean 基准上大幅提升成功率。
p.e: Proposes HyperTree Proof Search, inspired by AlphaZero, and learns continually from its own search results through online training, greatly raising success rates on Metamath and Lean benchmarks.

p.t: Draft, Sketch, and Prove: Guiding Formal Theorem Provers with Informal Proofs
p.d: 让语言模型先写出非形式化证明，再把它转换成形式化证明草图，由自动证明工具补全中间步骤，提升 Isabelle 中竞赛题的证明率。
p.e: Has a language model first write an informal proof, then turn it into a formal proof sketch whose intermediate steps are filled in by automated provers, raising the proof rate on competition problems in Isabelle.

p.t: DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5: Harnessing Proof Assistant Feedback for Reinforcement Learning and Monte-Carlo Tree Search
p.d: 用 Lean 证明助手的验证结果作为强化学习信号训练证明模型，并结合带内在奖励的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在 miniF2F 等基准上取得领先结果。
p.e: Trains a prover with reinforcement learning using verification results from the Lean proof assistant as the signal, combined with Monte Carlo tree search with intrinsic rewards, achieving leading results on miniF2F and other benchmarks.

p.t: Autoformalization with Large Language Models
p.d: 发现大型语言模型能把相当比例的竞赛数学题陈述正确翻译为 Isabelle 形式化语句，并用翻译结果训练证明器提高了基准成绩。
p.e: Finds that large language models can correctly translate a substantial share of competition problem statements into Isabelle formal statements, and uses the translations to train a prover that improves benchmark scores.

p.t: Solving olympiad geometry without human demonstrations
p.d: 不依赖人类示范，用大规模合成定理与证明训练语言模型提出辅助构造，并与符号推理引擎结合，解决了接近金牌选手水平的奥赛几何题。
p.e: Without human demonstrations, trains a language model on large-scale synthetic theorems and proofs to propose auxiliary constructions and combines it with a symbolic reasoning engine, solving olympiad geometry problems near gold-medallist level.

p.t: Olympiad-level formal mathematical reasoning with reinforcement learning
p.d: 把大量自然语言题目自动形式化为 Lean 语句，再用强化学习训练证明智能体，与 AlphaGeometry 2 一起在 2024 年国际数学奥林匹克中达到银牌水平。
p.e: Autoformalises a large number of natural-language problems into Lean statements and trains a proving agent with reinforcement learning; together with AlphaGeometry 2 it reached silver-medal level at the 2024 International Mathematical Olympiad.

p.t: Measuring Mathematical Problem Solving With the MATH Dataset
p.d: 构建包含一万二千多道高中竞赛题和逐步解答的 MATH 数据集，显示单纯扩大模型规模难以解决困难数学题。
p.e: Builds the MATH dataset of more than 12,000 high-school competition problems with step-by-step solutions, showing that simply scaling models struggles on hard mathematics.

p.t: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
p.d: 发布约八千五百道小学数学应用题的 GSM8K 数据集，并提出训练验证器对多个候选解打分重排，明显优于单纯微调。
p.e: Releases GSM8K, about 8,500 grade-school math word problems, and proposes training verifiers to score and rerank multiple candidate solutions, clearly outperforming fine-tuning alone.

p.t: Solving Quantitative Reasoning Problems with Language Models
p.d: 在包含数学公式的网页和 arXiv 论文上继续预训练语言模型，显著提升了在 MATH 等定量推理基准上的表现。
p.e: Continues pretraining a language model on web pages with mathematical notation and arXiv papers, markedly improving performance on quantitative reasoning benchmarks such as MATH.

p.t: Llemma: An Open Language Model for Mathematics
p.d: 在包含数学论文、网页和代码的 Proof-Pile-2 语料上继续预训练 Code Llama，得到开源数学语言模型，并公开数据与模型。
p.e: Continues pretraining Code Llama on Proof-Pile-2, a corpus of mathematical papers, web pages and code, producing an open mathematical language model and releasing both data and models.

p.t: Let's Verify Step by Step
p.d: 比较只奖励最终答案和奖励每一步推理两种监督方式，发现过程监督训练的奖励模型更可靠，并发布八十万条步骤级人工标注。
p.e: Compares rewarding only the final answer with rewarding each reasoning step, finds that reward models trained with process supervision are more reliable, and releases 800,000 step-level human labels.

p.t: Math-Shepherd: Verify and Reinforce LLMs Step-by-step without Human Annotations
p.d: 通过从每个中间步骤继续采样并检查能否得到正确答案，自动构造步骤级标签来训练过程奖励模型，并用于验证和强化学习。
p.e: Automatically constructs step-level labels by continuing sampling from each intermediate step and checking whether the correct answer is reached, training a process reward model used for verification and reinforcement learning.

p.t: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
p.d: 从网页中挖掘大规模数学语料继续预训练模型，并提出无需价值网络的组相对策略优化 GRPO，后来被广泛用于推理模型训练。
p.e: Continues pretraining on a large mathematical corpus mined from the web and proposes Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which needs no value network and was later widely used to train reasoning models.

p.t: STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning
p.d: 让模型生成推理过程，保留得到正确答案的推理链并反复微调，使模型在没有大量人工推理标注的情况下逐步提升推理能力。
p.e: Has a model generate rationales, keeps the chains that lead to correct answers and fine-tunes on them repeatedly, so reasoning improves without large amounts of human-written rationales.

p.t: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally Can be More Effective than Scaling Parameters for Reasoning
p.d: 系统研究推理时的搜索与修订策略，发现按题目难度自适应分配测试时计算，在一定条件下比扩大模型参数更有效。
p.e: Systematically studies search and revision strategies at inference time, finding that adaptively allocating test-time compute by problem difficulty can, under some conditions, beat scaling model parameters.

p.t: DeepSeek-R1 incentivizes reasoning in LLMs through reinforcement learning
p.d: 证明仅依靠基于规则的可验证奖励进行大规模强化学习，就能让语言模型自发产生长链推理、自我检查等行为，在数学与编程上表现突出。
p.e: Shows that large-scale reinforcement learning with only rule-based verifiable rewards makes language models spontaneously develop long-chain reasoning and self-checking, with strong results in mathematics and programming.

p.t: Generating conjectures on fundamental constants with the Ramanujan Machine
p.d: 用自动化算法搜索与 π、e 等基本常数相关的连分数表达式，生成了多个此前未知的公式猜想，其中一些随后被证明。
p.e: Uses automated algorithms to search for continued-fraction expressions related to fundamental constants such as π and e, generating several previously unknown formula conjectures, some later proved.

p.t: Advancing mathematics by guiding human intuition with AI
p.d: 用监督学习和归因分析帮助数学家发现数学对象之间的隐藏关系，在纽结理论中得到新定理，并在表示论中推进了组合不变性猜想。
p.e: Uses supervised learning and attribution analysis to help mathematicians discover hidden relationships between mathematical objects, yielding a new theorem in knot theory and progress on the combinatorial invariance conjecture in representation theory.

p.t: Murmurations of elliptic curves
p.d: 在用机器学习分析椭圆曲线数据时，发现按秩分组的弗罗贝尼乌斯迹平均值呈现类似椋鸟群飞的振荡图案，引发了后续理论研究。
p.e: While analysing elliptic curve data with machine learning, finds that averages of Frobenius traces grouped by rank show an oscillating pattern reminiscent of starling murmurations, prompting follow-up theoretical work.

p.t: Constructions in combinatorics via neural networks
p.d: 用简单的交叉熵强化学习方法搜索图和矩阵等组合对象，找到了若干图论猜想的反例，展示了神经网络辅助构造的潜力。
p.e: Searches combinatorial objects such as graphs and matrices with a simple cross-entropy reinforcement learning method, finding counterexamples to several graph theory conjectures and showing the potential of neural-network-assisted construction.

p.t: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
p.d: 让大型语言模型反复改写生成解的程序，并用自动评估器筛选，得到帽集问题中更大的构造以及更好的装箱启发式算法。
p.e: Has a large language model repeatedly rewrite programs that generate solutions, filtered by an automatic evaluator, obtaining larger constructions for the cap set problem and better bin-packing heuristics.

p.t: PatternBoost: Constructions in Mathematics with a Little Help from AI
p.d: 交替进行经典局部搜索和 Transformer 生成：先找出较好的例子，再训练模型生成相似候选，用于多个极值组合问题并找到一个长期猜想的反例。
p.e: Alternates classical local search with Transformer generation: find good examples, then train a model to generate similar candidates; applied to several extremal combinatorics problems, it found a counterexample to a long-standing conjecture.

p.t: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
p.d: 用大型语言模型驱动的演化式编码智能体改进算法和数学构造，例如把 4×4 复矩阵乘法降到 48 次标量乘法，并改进了多个组合与几何问题的已知界。
p.e: Uses an evolutionary coding agent driven by large language models to improve algorithms and mathematical constructions, for example reducing 4×4 complex matrix multiplication to 48 scalar multiplications and improving known bounds on several combinatorial and geometric problems.

p.t: Deep Learning For Symbolic Mathematics
p.d: 把符号积分和求解常微分方程表述为序列到序列翻译问题，用合成数据训练 Transformer，在这些任务上超过了部分商业计算机代数系统。
p.e: Frames symbolic integration and solving ordinary differential equations as sequence-to-sequence translation and trains Transformers on synthetic data, outperforming some commercial computer algebra systems on these tasks.

p.t: Discovering faster matrix multiplication algorithms with reinforcement learning
p.d: 把寻找矩阵乘法算法表述为张量分解的单人游戏，用强化学习找到了多个尺寸下乘法次数更少的算法，包括有限域上的 4×4 情形。
p.e: Frames finding matrix multiplication algorithms as a single-player tensor decomposition game and uses reinforcement learning to find algorithms with fewer multiplications for several sizes, including the 4×4 case over a finite field.

p.t: Faster sorting algorithms discovered using deep reinforcement learning
p.d: 把汇编程序编写变成强化学习游戏，发现了更快的小规模排序和哈希例程，相关代码已被并入 LLVM 的 C++ 标准库。
p.e: Turns writing assembly programs into a reinforcement learning game, discovering faster small sorting and hashing routines; the code has been merged into LLVM's C++ standard library.

p.t: Global Lyapunov functions: a long-standing open problem in mathematics, with symbolic transformers
p.d: 用反向生成的合成数据训练序列模型，为动力系统寻找全局李雅普诺夫函数，在多项式和非多项式系统上都优于传统算法和人类。
p.e: Trains sequence models on backward-generated synthetic data to find global Lyapunov functions for dynamical systems, outperforming traditional algorithms and humans on both polynomial and non-polynomial systems.

p.t: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
p.d: 提出 Adam 优化器，用梯度一阶矩和二阶矩的指数滑动平均自适应调整每个参数的学习率，成为深度学习最常用的优化器之一。
p.e: Introduces the Adam optimizer, which adapts each parameter's learning rate using exponential moving averages of the first and second moments of the gradient; one of the most widely used optimizers in deep learning.

p.t: On the Convergence of Adam and Beyond
p.d: 构造简单凸问题说明 Adam 可能不收敛，指出问题来自二阶矩的短期记忆，并提出保证收敛的修正算法 AMSGrad。
p.e: Constructs simple convex problems on which Adam can fail to converge, traces the problem to the short-term memory of the second moment, and proposes AMSGrad, a corrected algorithm with convergence guarantees.

p.t: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
p.d: 指出在自适应优化器中 L2 正则与权重衰减并不等价，提出把权重衰减与梯度更新解耦的 AdamW，改善了泛化。
p.e: Shows that L2 regularisation and weight decay are not equivalent in adaptive optimizers and proposes AdamW, which decouples weight decay from the gradient update and improves generalisation.

p.t: Gradient Descent on Neural Networks Typically Occurs at the Edge of Stability
p.d: 发现神经网络全批量梯度下降时，Hessian 最大特征值会增长到约等于 2 除以学习率并在附近徘徊，而损失仍非单调下降，挑战了经典优化假设。
p.e: Finds that in full-batch gradient descent on neural networks the largest Hessian eigenvalue rises to about 2 divided by the learning rate and hovers there while the loss keeps decreasing non-monotonically, challenging classical optimization assumptions.

p.t: Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Efficiently Improving Generalization
p.d: 提出锐度感知最小化，同时降低损失值和其邻域内的最坏损失，使模型收敛到更平坦的区域，在多个任务上提升泛化。
p.e: Proposes sharpness-aware minimization, which lowers both the loss and the worst-case loss in a neighbourhood, steering models to flatter regions and improving generalisation on many tasks.

p.t: Self-Stabilization: The Implicit Bias of Gradient Descent at the Edge of Stability
p.d: 从理论上解释稳定性边缘现象：梯度下降在不稳定方向上的振荡会通过三阶导数效应自动降低锐度，相当于隐式地约束了锐度。
p.e: Explains the edge of stability theoretically: oscillations of gradient descent along unstable directions reduce sharpness through a third-derivative effect, implicitly constraining sharpness.

p.t: The Implicit Bias of Gradient Descent on Separable Data
p.d: 证明在线性可分数据上用逻辑损失训练时，梯度下降的参数方向会收敛到硬间隔支持向量机的最大间隔解，即使没有显式正则。
p.e: Proves that when training with logistic loss on linearly separable data, the direction of gradient descent iterates converges to the maximum-margin hard-margin SVM solution, even without explicit regularisation.

p.t: Gradient Descent Provably Optimizes Over-parameterized Neural Networks
p.d: 证明对于足够宽的两层 ReLU 网络，随机初始化的梯度下降能以线性速率收敛到全局最优，关键在于训练中参数几乎不偏离初始化。
p.e: Proves that for sufficiently wide two-layer ReLU networks, randomly initialised gradient descent converges to the global optimum at a linear rate, because parameters barely move from initialisation during training.

p.t: A Convergence Theory for Deep Learning via Over-Parameterization
p.d: 证明在网络宽度关于样本数和深度为多项式时，随机梯度下降能在多项式时间内找到深层网络训练的全局最优。
p.e: Proves that when network width is polynomial in the number of samples and the depth, stochastic gradient descent finds global optima of deep network training in polynomial time.

p.t: Neural Tangent Kernel: Convergence and Generalization in Neural Networks
p.d: 证明在无限宽极限下，神经网络的梯度下降训练等价于用神经切线核做核方法，为分析训练和泛化提供了可计算的工具。
p.e: Proves that in the infinite-width limit, gradient descent training of a neural network is equivalent to a kernel method with the neural tangent kernel, providing a tractable tool for analysing training and generalisation.

p.t: Wide Neural Networks of Any Depth Evolve as Linear Models Under Gradient Descent
p.d: 证明并实验验证了任意深度的宽网络在梯度下降训练中可以用其在初始化处的线性化模型很好地近似。
p.e: Proves and verifies experimentally that wide networks of any depth trained by gradient descent are well approximated by their linearisation at initialisation.

p.t: Tensor Programs IV: Feature Learning in Infinite-Width Neural Networks
p.d: 指出标准参数化和 NTK 极限中特征在无限宽时不再变化，提出能保持特征学习的最大更新参数化 μP，并据此实现超参数跨宽度迁移。
p.e: Points out that features stop changing at infinite width under standard parameterisation and in the NTK limit, proposes the maximal update parameterisation μP that preserves feature learning, and uses it to transfer hyperparameters across widths.

p.t: Understanding deep learning requires rethinking generalization
p.d: 实验表明深度网络能完全拟合随机标签甚至随机像素，说明基于模型容量的传统泛化理论无法解释深度学习为何泛化。
p.e: Shows experimentally that deep networks can perfectly fit random labels and even random pixels, so classical capacity-based generalisation theory cannot explain why deep learning generalises.

p.t: Reconciling modern machine-learning practice and the classical bias–variance trade-off
p.d: 提出双下降曲线：模型复杂度超过刚好拟合训练数据的插值阈值后，测试误差会再次下降，把经典偏差方差权衡与现代实践统一起来。
p.e: Proposes the double descent curve: once model complexity passes the interpolation threshold where training data are fitted exactly, test error falls again, reconciling the classical bias–variance trade-off with modern practice.

p.t: Benign overfitting in linear regression
p.d: 刻画了线性回归中最小范数插值解能够良好泛化的条件，指出数据协方差需要有大量方差较小的方向来吸收噪声。
p.e: Characterises when the minimum-norm interpolating solution in linear regression generalises well, showing that the data covariance needs many low-variance directions to absorb the noise.

p.t: Deep Double Descent: Where Bigger Models and More Data Hurt
p.d: 在卷积网络和 Transformer 中系统观察到双下降现象，不仅随模型规模出现，也随训练轮数和样本量出现，有时更多数据反而有害。
p.e: Systematically observes double descent in convolutional networks and Transformers, not only in model size but also in training epochs and sample size; sometimes more data actually hurts.

p.t: Grokking: Generalization Beyond Overfitting on Small Algorithmic Datasets
p.d: 在模加法等小型算法任务上发现，网络在训练集准确率饱和很久之后，测试准确率才突然从随机水平跃升到接近完美，称为顿悟现象。
p.e: On small algorithmic tasks such as modular addition, finds that test accuracy jumps suddenly from chance to near perfect long after training accuracy saturates, a phenomenon called grokking.

p.t: Progress measures for grokking via mechanistic interpretability
p.d: 通过机制可解释性完全逆向出网络做模加法时使用的离散傅里叶变换算法，并据此定义进度指标，说明顿悟是逐步形成的而非突变。
p.e: Fully reverse-engineers, through mechanistic interpretability, the discrete Fourier transform algorithm a network uses for modular addition, and defines progress measures showing that grokking forms gradually rather than abruptly.

p.t: An empirical analysis of compute-optimal large language model training
p.d: 通过大量训练实验估计计算最优的缩放关系，发现模型参数量与训练数据量应大致等比例扩大，并据此训练了更小但更强的 Chinchilla。
p.e: Estimates compute-optimal scaling relationships from extensive training runs, finding that model size and training data should grow in roughly equal proportion, and accordingly trains the smaller but stronger Chinchilla.

p.t: Explaining neural scaling laws
p.d: 提出解释神经网络缩放律的理论框架，区分方差受限和分辨率受限两类缩放区间，并在可解模型与实际网络中加以验证。
p.e: Proposes a theoretical framework for neural scaling laws, distinguishing variance-limited and resolution-limited scaling regimes and verifying them in solvable models and real networks.

p.t: Estimation of Non-Normalized Statistical Models by Score Matching
p.d: 提出分数匹配方法，通过拟合对数密度关于数据的梯度来估计未归一化的概率模型，避免计算归一化常数，是分数生成模型的理论起点。
p.e: Proposes score matching, which estimates unnormalised probability models by fitting the gradient of the log-density with respect to the data, avoiding the normalising constant; the theoretical starting point of score-based generative models.

p.t: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
p.d: 用随机微分方程统一扩散模型与分数生成模型，生成即求解逆时间 SDE，并给出可精确计算似然的概率流常微分方程。
p.e: Unifies diffusion models and score-based generative models with stochastic differential equations, so generation means solving a reverse-time SDE, and gives a probability flow ODE with exact likelihoods.

p.s: Sampling is as easy as learning the score
p.t: Sampling is as easy as learning the score: theory for diffusion models with minimal data assumptions
p.d: 证明在很弱的数据分布假设下，只要分数估计误差足够小，扩散模型的采样误差就可以被多项式级别的步数控制。
p.e: Proves that under very weak assumptions on the data distribution, as long as the score estimation error is small enough, the sampling error of diffusion models can be controlled with a polynomial number of steps.

p.t: A computational fluid mechanics solution to the Monge-Kantorovich mass transfer problem
p.d: 提出最优传输的动态表述：在连续性方程约束下最小化速度场的总动能，这一视角是流匹配等连续时间生成模型的数学基础。
p.e: Proposes the dynamic formulation of optimal transport: minimise the total kinetic energy of a velocity field subject to the continuity equation; this view is the mathematical foundation of continuous-time generative models such as flow matching.

p.t: Sinkhorn Distances: Lightspeed Computation of Optimal Transport
p.d: 提出在最优传输中加入熵正则，使其可用简单的 Sinkhorn 矩阵缩放迭代快速求解，让最优传输距离在机器学习中变得实用。
p.e: Proposes adding entropic regularisation to optimal transport so it can be solved quickly with simple Sinkhorn matrix-scaling iterations, making optimal transport distances practical in machine learning.

p.t: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
p.d: 提出整流流，学习连接两个分布、尽可能走直线的常微分方程，并通过反复整流使路径更直，从而能用很少步数生成样本。
p.e: Proposes rectified flow, which learns an ODE connecting two distributions along paths that are as straight as possible and straightens them further by repeated rectification, so samples can be generated in very few steps.

p.t: Building Normalizing Flows with Stochastic Interpolants
p.d: 用连接两个分布的插值过程定义速度场，通过简单的二次损失训练连续时间正规化流，为统一流模型和扩散模型提供了框架。
p.e: Defines a velocity field through an interpolation process connecting two distributions and trains continuous-time normalising flows with a simple quadratic loss, providing a framework that unifies flow and diffusion models.

p.t: Convergence for score-based generative modeling with polynomial complexity
p.d: 在分数估计误差有界的条件下，给出分数生成模型采样误差的多项式复杂度收敛界，是扩散模型理论分析的早期代表。
p.e: Gives polynomial-complexity convergence bounds on the sampling error of score-based generative models under bounded score error; an early representative of diffusion model theory.

p.t: Score Approximation, Estimation and Distribution Recovery of Diffusion Models on Low-Dimensional Data
p.d: 研究数据位于低维线性子空间时扩散模型的分数逼近与估计，证明分布恢复的统计误差率取决于内在维数而不是环境维数。
p.e: Studies score approximation and estimation for diffusion models when data lie in a low-dimensional linear subspace, proving that the statistical error rate of distribution recovery depends on the intrinsic rather than the ambient dimension.

p.t: Nearly $d$-Linear Convergence Bounds for Diffusion Models via Stochastic Localization
p.d: 借助随机局部化技术，在只要求数据分布有有限二阶矩的条件下，证明扩散模型所需步数对数据维数只有近似线性的依赖。
p.e: Uses stochastic localisation to prove, assuming only finite second moments of the data distribution, that the number of steps diffusion models need depends nearly linearly on the data dimension.

p.m: IEEE Signal Processing Magazine 2017 · 较早入口
p.t: Geometric Deep Learning: Going beyond Euclidean data
p.d: 综述把深度学习推广到图和流形等非欧几里得数据的方法，梳理谱方法与空间方法，奠定了几何深度学习这一方向的框架。
p.e: Surveys methods that extend deep learning to non-Euclidean data such as graphs and manifolds, organising spectral and spatial approaches and laying out the framework of geometric deep learning.

p.t: Group Equivariant Convolutional Networks
p.d: 提出群等变卷积网络，把平移等变推广到旋转和反射等对称群，在不增加参数的前提下提升了模型的表达效率。
p.e: Introduces group equivariant convolutional networks, extending translation equivariance to symmetry groups such as rotations and reflections and improving expressive efficiency without extra parameters.

p.t: A General Theory of Equivariant CNNs on Homogeneous Spaces
p.d: 用纤维丛和诱导表示的语言给出齐性空间上等变卷积网络的一般理论，证明等变线性映射都可写成带约束核的卷积。
p.e: Gives a general theory of equivariant convolutional networks on homogeneous spaces in the language of fibre bundles and induced representations, proving that every equivariant linear map is a convolution with a constrained kernel.

p.t: Universal Invariant and Equivariant Graph Neural Networks
p.d: 证明由高阶张量线性等变层构成的一类图神经网络，可以一致逼近图上的任意连续不变或等变函数。
p.e: Proves that a class of graph neural networks built from linear equivariant layers on higher-order tensors can uniformly approximate any continuous invariant or equivariant function on graphs.

p.t: E(n) Equivariant Graph Neural Networks
p.d: 提出 E(n) 等变图神经网络，通过点间距离和相对位置更新特征与坐标，无需昂贵的球谐函数即可实现旋转、平移和反射等变。
p.e: Introduces E(n)-equivariant graph neural networks, which update features and coordinates from pairwise distances and relative positions, achieving rotation, translation and reflection equivariance without costly spherical harmonics.

p.t: Scalars are universal: Equivariant machine learning, structured like classical physics
p.d: 借助经典不变量理论证明，满足正交群等物理对称性的等变函数都可以用向量间的内积等标量来表示，从而得到简单的通用等变模型。
p.e: Uses classical invariant theory to prove that equivariant functions respecting physical symmetries such as orthogonal groups can be expressed through scalars like inner products between vectors, yielding simple universal equivariant models.

p.t: How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?
p.d: 证明消息传递图神经网络区分图的能力不超过一维 Weisfeiler–Leman 检验，并提出能达到这一上界的图同构网络 GIN。
p.e: Proves that message-passing graph neural networks are at most as powerful as the one-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman test at distinguishing graphs, and proposes the Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN), which reaches this bound.

p.t: Weisfeiler and Leman Go Neural: Higher-order Graph Neural Networks
p.d: 同样建立了图神经网络与一维 WL 检验的等价关系，并提出基于高阶 WL 的 k-GNN，可以区分更多非同构图。
p.e: Likewise establishes the equivalence between graph neural networks and the 1-WL test, and proposes k-GNNs based on higher-order WL that distinguish more non-isomorphic graphs.

p.t: Provably Powerful Graph Networks
p.d: 提出一种利用矩阵乘法的简单图网络架构，可证明达到三维 WL 检验的区分能力，同时计算代价可控。
p.e: Proposes a simple graph network architecture using matrix multiplication that provably matches the distinguishing power of the 3-WL test at manageable computational cost.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2009 · 较早入口
p.t: A new upper bound for diagonal Ramsey numbers
p.d: 把对角 Ramsey 数 R(k) 的 Erdős–Szekeres 上界改进了一个超多项式因子，是该问题此后十多年的最好结果。
p.e: Improves the Erdős–Szekeres upper bound on the diagonal Ramsey number R(k) by a superpolynomial factor; the best result on the problem for more than a decade afterwards.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2026 · 近年代表
p.t: An exponential improvement for diagonal Ramsey
p.d: 证明存在常数 ε>0 使 R(k) ≤ (4−ε)^k，这是对 1935 年 Erdős–Szekeres 上界的首次指数级改进。
p.e: Proves that there is a constant ε > 0 with R(k) ≤ (4−ε)^k, the first exponential improvement on the 1935 Erdős–Szekeres upper bound.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2024 · 已有扩展
p.t: The asymptotics of r(4,t)
p.d: 构造性地证明 r(4,t) 至少约为 t³/log⁴t，与已知上界只差对数因子，解决了 Erdős 提出的长期问题。
p.e: Proves constructively that r(4,t) is at least about t³/log⁴t, matching the known upper bound up to logarithmic factors and resolving a long-standing problem posed by Erdős.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2019 · 较早入口
p.t: Induced subgraphs of hypercubes and a proof of the Sensitivity Conjecture
p.d: 证明 n 维超立方体任意 2^{n−1}+1 个顶点的诱导子图最大度至少为 √n，从而用极短的论证解决了布尔函数中的敏感度猜想。
p.e: Proves that every induced subgraph on 2^{n−1}+1 vertices of the n-dimensional hypercube has maximum degree at least √n, settling the sensitivity conjecture for Boolean functions with a remarkably short argument.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2021 · 近年代表
p.t: Improved bounds for the sunflower lemma
p.d: 显著改进了 Erdős–Rado 向日葵引理中的界，把所需集合数量从约 k^k 降到约 (log k)^k 量级。
p.e: Substantially improves the bound in the Erdős–Rado sunflower lemma, reducing the required number of sets from about k^k to about (log k)^k.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2021 · 近年代表
p.t: Thresholds versus fractional expectation-thresholds
p.d: 证明随机结构中单调性质的阈值至多比分数期望阈值大一个对数因子，解决了 Talagrand 的猜想，并推出多个经典阈值结果。
p.e: Proves that the threshold of a monotone property of random structures exceeds its fractional expectation threshold by at most a logarithmic factor, resolving Talagrand's conjecture and implying several classical threshold results.

p.t: A constant lower bound for the union-closed sets conjecture
p.d: 用信息论中的熵方法证明，任意非平凡并封闭集合族中存在某个元素属于至少百分之一的集合，首次给出常数比例下界。
p.e: Uses the entropy method from information theory to prove that every non-trivial union-closed family has an element contained in at least one per cent of the sets, the first constant-fraction lower bound.

p.m: Journal of the American Mathematical Society 2024 · 已有扩展
p.t: A proof of the Kahn–Kalai conjecture
p.d: 证明任意单调性质的阈值概率至多是其期望阈值乘以对数因子，完整解决了 Kahn 与 Kalai 于 2006 年提出的猜想。
p.e: Proves that the threshold probability of any monotone property is at most its expectation threshold times a logarithmic factor, fully resolving the conjecture posed by Kahn and Kalai in 2006.

p.t: Strong Bounds for 3-Progressions
p.d: 证明 {1,…,N} 中不含三项等差数列的集合大小至多为 N·exp(−c(log N)^{1/12})，远超此前的对数级改进。
p.e: Proves that a subset of {1,…,N} without three-term arithmetic progressions has size at most N·exp(−c(log N)^{1/12}), far beyond earlier logarithmic-scale improvements.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2025 · 已有扩展
p.t: On a conjecture of Marton
p.d: 证明 F₂ⁿ 中倍集较小的集合可被多项式个数的子群陪集覆盖，即多项式 Freiman–Ruzsa 猜想，其证明随后在 Lean 中完成形式化。
p.e: Proves that a subset of F₂ⁿ with small doubling can be covered by polynomially many cosets of a subgroup, the polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa conjecture; the proof was soon formalised in Lean.

p.t: Improved Bounds for Szemerédi's Theorem
p.d: 对所有 k≥5，证明不含 k 项等差数列的集合密度至多为 exp(−(log log N)^{c_k}) 量级，改进了 Gowers 以来的定量界。
p.e: Proves for all k ≥ 5 that sets without k-term arithmetic progressions have density at most of order exp(−(log log N)^{c_k}), improving the quantitative bounds that stood since Gowers.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2014 · 较早入口
p.t: Bounded gaps between primes
p.d: 首次证明存在无穷多对相邻素数，它们之间的差不超过七千万，开启了孪生素数猜想方向的一系列进展。
p.e: Proves for the first time that infinitely many pairs of consecutive primes differ by at most 70 million, launching a series of advances toward the twin prime conjecture.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2015 · 近年代表
p.t: Small gaps between primes
p.d: 用新的多维 Selberg 筛法把有界间隔改进到 600 以内，并证明对任意 m，存在无穷多个包含 m 个素数的有界长度区间。
p.e: Uses a new multidimensional Selberg sieve to bring bounded gaps below 600 and proves that for any m there are infinitely many bounded intervals containing m primes.

p.t: New large value estimates for Dirichlet polynomials
p.d: 得到狄利克雷多项式取大值次数的新估计，从而改进了 Ingham 在 1940 年给出的黎曼 ζ 函数零点密度界，以及短区间中素数分布的结果。
p.e: Obtains new estimates on how often Dirichlet polynomials take large values, improving Ingham's 1940 zero-density bound for the Riemann zeta function and results on primes in short intervals.

p.m: Publications mathématiques de l'IHÉS 2021 · 已有扩展
p.t: Symmetric power functoriality for holomorphic modular forms
p.d: 证明全纯模形式在任意对称幂下的朗兰兹函子性，由此推出 Sato–Tate 分布等方面的强结论。
p.e: Proves Langlands functoriality for all symmetric powers of holomorphic modular forms, yielding strong consequences such as results on the Sato–Tate distribution.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2017 · 较早入口
p.t: The sphere packing problem in dimension 8
p.d: 用模形式构造满足线性规划界的特殊函数，证明 E8 格给出 8 维空间中最密的球堆积。
p.e: Constructs a special function from modular forms that meets the linear programming bound, proving that the E8 lattice gives the densest sphere packing in 8 dimensions.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2017 · 近年代表
p.t: The sphere packing problem in dimension 24
p.d: 把 8 维的模形式方法推广到 24 维，证明 Leech 格给出 24 维空间中最密的球堆积。
p.e: Extends the 8-dimensional modular-form method to 24 dimensions, proving that the Leech lattice gives the densest sphere packing in 24 dimensions.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2020 · 已有扩展
p.t: The Conway knot is not slice
p.d: 通过构造与 Conway 纽结具有相同四维纽结迹的另一纽结，并用 Rasmussen 不变量证明其不是切片纽结，解决了五十年的问题。
p.e: Constructs another knot with the same four-dimensional knot trace as the Conway knot and uses Rasmussen's invariant to prove it is not slice, resolving a fifty-year-old question.

p.t: Proof of the geometric Langlands conjecture I: construction of the functor
p.d: 几何朗兰兹猜想完整证明系列论文的第一篇，构造了从自守侧到谱侧的朗兰兹函子，后续论文证明它是范畴等价。
p.e: The first paper in the series completing the proof of the geometric Langlands conjecture, constructing the Langlands functor from the automorphic to the spectral side; later papers prove it is an equivalence of categories.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2015 · 较早入口
p.t: The proof of the $l^2$ Decoupling Conjecture
p.d: 证明了关于曲面上傅里叶扩张的 ℓ² 解耦猜想，这一工具随后被广泛用于指数和、偏微分方程和数论问题。
p.e: Proves the ℓ² decoupling conjecture for Fourier extension on curved surfaces, a tool later widely used for exponential sums, partial differential equations and number theory.

p.m: Annals of Mathematics 2016 · 近年代表
p.t: Proof of the main conjecture in Vinogradov's mean value theorem for degrees higher than three
p.d: 利用解耦不等式证明 Vinogradov 平均值定理在次数大于三时的主猜想，展示了调和分析方法在解析数论中的力量。
p.e: Uses decoupling inequalities to prove the main conjecture of Vinogradov's mean value theorem for degrees higher than three, showing the power of harmonic analysis in analytic number theory.

p.t: Volume estimates for unions of convex sets, and the Kakeya set conjecture in three dimensions
p.d: 通过对凸集并的体积估计，证明三维空间中包含每个方向单位线段的 Kakeya 集具有完整的 Hausdorff 与 Minkowski 维数 3。
p.e: Through volume estimates for unions of convex sets, proves that Kakeya sets in three-dimensional space, which contain a unit segment in every direction, have full Hausdorff and Minkowski dimension 3.
